metadata.description: Marketplace for Claude Quota Guardian — a safety net for long Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: quota-guardian
plugins.description: Watches your real Claude account quota (5h session, weekly, per-model) and forces a resumable checkpoint right before the cutoff, so the next session continues with almost no tokens.

plugins.name: quota-guardian-bar
plugins.description: Live prompt-cache countdown above the prompt, with context size, 5h and weekly quota, and a one-click handoff through /continuity-checkpoint. Install together with quota-guardian.
